messages:
Maria S: Heads-up — we have an external pen-test scheduled for next Wed (03/30). Window TBD but likely 09:00-17:00 UTC. Need to finalize privileged-role changes + KMS/access plan and an audit-log export path for the assessor. Quick questions:

Maria S: 1) Are we rotating ephemeral KMS keys for assessor access or giving time-boxed access to an existing key? 2) Are we ready to split the current `admin` role into `infra-admin` + `svc-deployer` for least-privilege? 3) How will we package logs for evidence (format + retention)?

Jonathan I: We planned ephemeral access via kms-proxy (short-lived certs). Current plan is 24h creds issued via the assessor onboarding flow, but we can extend to 72h for the engagement if needed.

Jonathan I: We also have the IAM split RFC up in #eng-iam — infra-admin = infra ops + key management, svc-deployer = CI/CD/service deploy rights. I can post the minimal deltas here.

Sara P: We need an evidence chain: CloudTrail (management plane), app telemetry (structured logs), and KMS keystore wrap/unwrap audit entries. Assessor should get a read-only evidence bundle — no write, no ability to change rules.

Tim O: Oncall/eng-sre can run the log export. Strongly recommend a dry-run export (1h window) to validate bundle format and checksums. @deploy-bot can schedule the job.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot scheduled job -> log-export: export-pt-6234, run at 2026-03-25T18:00Z UTC, target: cloudtrail+applogs+kms-audit. Status: queued.

Maria S: For RBAC, here's a strawman snippet — please review and correct before we apply to staging:

Maria S: ```yaml
roles:
  infra-admin:
    permissions:
      - kms:ManageKeys
      - iam:CreateServiceAccount
      - logs:Read,*
  svc-deployer:
    permissions:
      - iam:AssumeRole:ci-deploy
      - ecs:Deploy
      - logs:Read
  assessor-readonly:
    permissions:
      - kms:Decrypt:read-audit
      - logs:Read
      - iam:GetRole
```

Jonathan I: Two notes: 1) We should scope `kms:Decrypt` to a separate audit key alias (alias/pt-assessor) and enable key-usage logging. 2) Also lock the assessor principal to a staging VPC subnet to reduce blast radius.

Latha K: On KMS ops: enable key-usage-audit flag on the PT key (so unwrap/wrap events include principal and request context). Add tag `pt:assessor` to any ephemeral keys/aliases. We'll need to capture that tag during evidence export.

Sara P: For acceptance/retreat criteria for retest: critical findings must be closed, and medium findings must either be closed or have documented mitigations + PR/issue linked. Also include a mapping file that shows which config change fixed which finding.

Tim O: I'll own the dry-run and the final export. Action: schedule dry-run (2026-03-25), verify checksums and upload bundle to secure readroom. Also: can we snapshot any relevant VMs for repro?

Ben R: Eng-sre can snapshot images, but want to minimize disk footprint. We'll take minimal snapshots of app VMs and DB replicas (read-only snapshots). Need cost center approval — please include in ticket.

Maria S: Also: network controls — lock egress for assessor SA so it can only reach log collector and auditor endpoints. No external internet access. Jonathan, can you add egress SG rules?

Jonathan I: Yep, will apply staging SG rule and include IP allowlist for audit collector.

Maria S: Action items (assignments):
- Latha K: enable key-usage-audit + tag ephemeral keys `pt:assessor`
- Jonathan I: apply role split RFC deltas and staging SG egress rule
- Tim O: schedule dry-run export + final export, verify checksum and upload to readroom
- Sara P: assemble evidence-bundle checklist and acceptance criteria doc
- Ben R: snapshot plan and cost approval guidance

Maria S: Can people ack so I can open the pen-test ticket with owners?

Jonathan I: ack :thumbsup:

Latha K: ack — will enable audit flag today. :white_check_mark:

Sara P: ack, I'll start the evidence checklist and sample manifest.

Tim O: ack — will schedule dry-run and add run notes to ticket.

Ben R: ack — will draft snapshot constraints and cost note.

Maria S: Perfect. I'll create a tracker ticket with the above owners + timeline and link the dry-run job id. Will follow up with the assessor onboarding doc and readroom details. Thanks everyone :raised_hands:
